newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MUSIC plans Nasdaq listing in 1997.
newsitem.headline: MUSIC plans Nasdaq listing in 1997.

text.p: Philippines' MUSIC Semiconductors Inc is planning to list its shares in the United States' Nasdaq board next year, MUSIC chairman Michael Burton said on Tuesday.
"We are planning to see the listing of our shares on Nasdaq sometime in 1997," Burton told Reuters in a telephone interview.
MUSIC is the only high-technology stock listed on the Philippine Stock Exchange. It is engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of computer network systems.
Burton said the company is scheduled to meet 20 U.S. investment banks to select who will underwrite the shares offering.

"In selecting the underwriter, we are looking for a bank that has an in-depth knowledge of the market of network system, who knows all the players ... (Because) we might be interested to do more acquisitions and seek strategic partners in the future," Burton added.
He said the listing will not be solely for fund raising purposes, but mainly to enhance the company's value since Nasdaq investors are very familiar with the high-technology industry.

MUSIC shares have been steadily rising since its listing in late September amidst a consolidating market. The share had gone up to as high as 11 pesos from its September 26 offer price of 6.30 pesos per share. On Tuesday, it closed at 10.75 pesos. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
